newsitem.title: USA: Madonna gives birth to baby girl.
newsitem.headline: Madonna gives birth to baby girl.

text.p: Pop star Madonna gave birth on Monday to a baby girl, her publicist Liz Rosenberg said.
She said the baby, named Lourdes Maria Ciccone Leon, weighed in at 6 pounds 9 ounces (2.97 kilos), at the Good Samaritan hospital in Los Angeles.
The spokeswoman said the "healthy baby girl" was born at 4.01 p.m. (7. 01 p.m. EDT/2301 GMT)
"Mother Madonna Ciccone, father Carlos Leon and their daughter are all resting comfortably," she said in a statement to Reuters.
Rosenberg added that there would be "absolutely" no further information released about the birth.
